[DEFINE_WORKER: "Builds a grid of slashes and backslashes from the ball counts in B, returning the number of rows in that grid and the grid itself, or ('IMPOSSIBLE', None) when an endpoint ball count is zero." solve]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> B </REF>: list of integers "Ball counts for each column of the grid; the first and last values determine feasibility."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: tuple (int, list of list of str) or tuple (str, None) "Returns (grid_row_count, grid) for the constructed dot/slash/backslash grid, or ('IMPOSSIBLE', None) when B[0] or B[-1] is zero."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate the guard condition B[0] == 0 or B[-1] == 0. RESULT endpoint_guard]
            [COMMAND Set C to len(B). RESULT C]
            [COMMAND Initialize grid as an empty list; the second empty-list assignment overwrites the first. RESULT grid]
            [COMMAND For each j from 0 to C-1 inclusive, create row as an empty list; for each i from 0 to C-1 inclusive, append '.' to row; after the inner loop, append row to grid. RESULT grid]
            [COMMAND Set shadowed to a list of False values with length equal to len(C), then set shadowed[0] to True. RESULT shadowed]
            [COMMAND Decrement B[0] by 1 and decrement B[-1] by 1. RESULT B]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 to C-1 inclusive, first check if B[i] == 0 and shadowed[i] is True; if so, continue to the next i and skip the rest of the loop body. RESULT skip_decision]
            [COMMAND Within the same for loop over i, if B[i] > 0 and shadowed[i] is False, initialize unshadowed_balls = 0, j = i - 1, and l = 1 for the left-side scan. RESULT left_scan_state]
            [COMMAND During the left-side scan, while j >= 1 and shadowed[j] is False, set grid[l][j] to a backslash character, mark shadowed[j] as True, increment unshadowed_balls by 1, increment l by 1, and decrement j by 1. RESULT left_scan_state]
            [COMMAND Within the same for loop, after the left scan, if B[i] <= unshadowed_balls, compute excess_balls = unshadowed_balls - B[i] + 1, set j = i, and while excess_balls > 1, decrement j by 1, decrement excess_balls by 1, and set shadowed[j] to False. RESULT shadowed]
            [COMMAND Within the same for loop, if B[i] > unshadowed_balls, which is the else branch of the previous condition, subtract unshadowed_balls + 1 from B[i] and set shadowed[i] to True. RESULT B_and_shadowed]
            [COMMAND Within the same for loop, if B[i] > 0 and shadowed[i] is True, initialize r = B[i], j = i + 1, and l = 1 for the right-side scan. RESULT right_scan_state]
            [COMMAND During the right-side scan, while j < C - 1 and shadowed[j] is True, set grid[l][j] to a forward slash character, increment l by 1, and increment j by 1, without consuming r. RESULT grid]
            [COMMAND Continuing the right-side scan, while j < C - 1 and r > 0, set grid[l][j] to a forward slash character, mark shadowed[j] as True, decrement r by 1, increment l by 1, and increment j by 1. RESULT grid_and_shadowed_and_r]
            [COMMAND After the for loop over i, initialize ans as an empty list. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND For each index from 1 to C-1 inclusive, assign row = grid[index], set include_row to False, and if any cell in row is a backslash or a forward slash, set include_row to True and break the inner cell scan. RESULT include_row]
            [COMMAND Within that row loop, if include_row is True, append row to ans; otherwise break the row loop immediately. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Prepend a new row of C '.' cells to ans by assigning ans = [['.' for i in range(C)]] + ans. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Return the tuple (len(ans), ans). RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If B[0] == 0 or B[-1] == 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return the tuple ('IMPOSSIBLE', None) immediately. RESULT impossible_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
